subject: Your missing %
author: ZombieTron
body:
lies in those 40 missing showtime scores.

You need to get EVERYTHING done in the offline game to get 100% offline, then you get 101% for doing the 2 blocks of freeburn challenges online.

I guess if you have already done the challenges, and you just need to do the showtime's offline, if you take the time to do those, you will be 101%.
